# `smelt.transcript`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo run -p tui --bin gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Tier:** `UiHost` — Requires a terminal UI; calling these from headless mode raises.

Read rendered transcript display text and yank the current block. UiHost-only.

## `smelt.transcript.text`

```lua
fun(): string
```

Return the full transcript as a single newline-joined string (post-render display text, with thinking blocks visible according to the `show_thinking` setting).

## `smelt.transcript.yank_block`

```lua
fun(): nil
```

Copy the transcript block under the cursor to the system clipboard. Notifies the user with the copied range; no-op when the cursor is outside any block.
